questions.def: Use past perfect for actions finished before another past action.
questions.question: By the time I arrived, the movie ___.

questions.def: 'Used to' describes past habits or states that are no longer true.
questions.question: She ___ in Paris when she was younger.

questions.def: Past perfect needed to show action finished before retirement.
questions.question: He ___ at that company before he retired.

questions.def: 'Wish' + past perfect expresses regret about the past.
questions.question: I wish I ___ harder in school.

questions.def: Simple past for finished actions with a past time marker.
questions.question: They ___ the project last week.

questions.def: Past simple 'was' for describing past events.
questions.question: There ___ a big storm last night.

questions.def: Past continuous interrupted by a simple past action.
questions.question: While I was cooking, he ___ the dishes.

questions.def: Past perfect after 'told' to show earlier action.
questions.question: He told me that he ___ to the party.

questions.def: 'Know' is a stative verb, not used in continuous tenses.
questions.question: I am knowing him since we were kids.

questions.def: Completed action in the past with a duration.
questions.question: They ___ in that house for five years.

questions.def: Past continuous describes an ongoing action.
questions.question: She ___ reading when the phone rang.

questions.def: Past perfect for actions before another action in the past.
questions.question: By the time the police arrived, the thief ___.

questions.def: Simple past tense for a completed past action.
questions.question: I ___ French in high school.

questions.def: 'Was going to' expresses an unfulfilled intention.
questions.question: I ___ to call you earlier, but I forgot.

questions.def: Simple past for a completed action with a past time marker.
questions.question: They ___ to the concert last night.

questions.def: Use simple past with 'yesterday', not present perfect.
questions.question: She has finished her work yesterday.

questions.def: Simple past for a completed action with a past time marker.
questions.question: We ___ Italy last summer.

questions.def: Past continuous interrupted by simple past.
questions.question: He ___ playing the guitar when he broke his arm.

questions.def: Past perfect shows action before another past action.
questions.question: She ___ the movie before I did.

questions.def: Use 'have known' to describe a state over time.
questions.question: I am knowing her since last year.

questions.def: Use past perfect for actions completed before another past action.
questions.question: I ___ dinner before you arrived.

questions.def: 'Used to' describes past habits or states that are no longer true.
questions.question: They ___ to be good friends when they were younger.

questions.def: Past continuous interrupted by simple past.
questions.question: While she was studying, I ___ the house.

questions.def: Simple past tense for a completed past action.
questions.question: I ___ her at the conference last week.

questions.def: Simple past tense for a completed past action.
questions.question: She ___ to the gym every day last year.

questions.def: Past perfect shows action before another past action.
questions.question: Before I left, I ___ my keys.

questions.def: Past perfect is needed because it happened before 'arrived'.
questions.question: By the time he arrived, the movie ___.

questions.def: 'Was going to' expresses an unfulfilled intention in the past.
questions.question: I ___ to call you yesterday, but I forgot.

questions.def: Use 'has been' or 'was' after since.
questions.question: She has lived in Paris since she is a child.

questions.def: Past continuous for an activity over a period in the past.
questions.question: They ___ on the project all day yesterday.
